posts.author: Ayoub_Kel
posts.body:
Hello, it's my first time using RPG MAKER MV, and I don't know how to use tilesets.
I already uploaded a photo to the resource manage (img/tilesets) but I can't find it in tilesets database, what to do?

posts.author: B3N4ZC4L
posts.body:
One of the few things you should check is, if the image file has the .png at the end.
.PNG might seem to be the same but you need to make sure that your image is a .png file.
after importing your image I suggest saving your project and re-open rpg maker mv so that it will read the file as I'm not certain if it will automatically read the new file like MZ does.

posts.author: pawsplay
posts.body: What do you mean, a photo?

posts.author: Timeline_man
posts.body: just to cover bases here: Are you sure you're looking in the right place? Because you have to add the tileset image to a tileset before it'll show up in the database.
